headline: Farol Capital Reaches R$1 Billion in Assets Under Custody
summary: Brazil's Farol Capital Group reached R$1 billion in assets under custody after nine years of operation, while expanding its business scope beyond investments.
why: Asset management growth milestones reflect rising retail and institutional capital inflows within Latin America's wealth management sector.

impacts.name: Farol Capital
impacts.why: Reaching R$1 billion in custody expands fee-generating asset bases.
